name: Mixer Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a stand mixer with a white stand, an orange head with Rotom's face, steel whisks and a purple bowl
entry: It whips cream and beats eggs with startling force. Its whisks have punched holes in kitchen walls.
how: Use a Mixer Whisk on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Focus Blast in this form.
